label: prf:brings-riemann-hurwitz
title: Proof of the Riemann--Hurwitz count for $\Sigma_4 \to \mathbb{P}(V)$
html: Proof. The Reeb quotient M_S \to \Sigma_4 collapses the \mathrm{U}(1)-orbits of the circle bundle (weight-0 subalgebra A_0 = A^{\mathrm{U}(1)}). The covering \pi \colon \Sigma_4 \to \mathbb{P}(V) is the map to the projective line induced by the linear system |K_{\Sigma_4}|; it has degree 4 and genus 4 source, so by Riemann--Hurwitz R_{\mathrm{tot}} = 2g(\Sigma_4) - 2 - 4(2g(\mathbb{P}^1) - 2) = 6 - 4(-2) = 14. The S_5-symmetry of \Sigma_4 forces the 14 units of ramification to be distributed over exactly 6 branch points (with ramification indices determined by the cycle types of S_5). \square
